scope: Planned coverage, not execution. Every exact test/config/command reference records current existence and owning task(s). New tests require meaningful RED, never empty stubs. Plan-level threat references are conservative; actual owner tests must prove mitigation.

plans.objective: Attested environment contracts and exact test discovery.
Bound shared managed JWKS transport.
Audited payment-resolution ledger and atomic safe clearance.
Provider-authoritative reconciliation worker.
Private operator payment-case resolver.
Source-backed public eligibility and canonical host policy.
Authoritative public discovery metadata projection.
Truthful escaped JSON-LD and actual browser discovery.
Generate public connection artifacts from canonical contracts.
Select external accounts, resource budget and human owners.
Provision selected isolated staging and synthetic cohort.
Review and apply complete staging database and runtime.
Genuine managed auth, provider, reconciliation and rollback acceptance.
Implement guarded actual Playwright API/MCP pilot driver.
Watched operations runbook and named-agent evidence harness.
Human-controlled Dot or another real-agent rehearsal.
Reproducible dependency, public discovery and release checks.
Review readiness for a small watched pilot.
Wire source-backed marketplace routes and crawler policy.
Serve public agent guides and prove HTTP/OAuth discovery.
Execute provider-confirmed pilot and publish actual receipts.
Validated next-phase feedback and maintenance ownership.
